object.script:
s,i,o,p,m = self,input,output,property,math pgn,pgb,gn,gb,sn,sb = p.getNumber,p.getBool,i.getNumber,i.getBool,o.setNumber,o.setBool abs = m.abs
rpsMin = m.max(pgn("RPS at throttle 0"), 2.1) rpsMax = m.max(pgn("RPS at throttle 1"), rpsMin) mix = pgb("Mixture control") stoP = pgn("Stoichiometry") afrP = pgn("Air-to-Fuel ratio") prot = pgn("Overheat protection") mode = pgb("RPS control") opt = pgb("Optimal mixture at high throttle") auto = not pgb("Autostart if engine stalls")
heat,start,stall,cyl = false,false,false,false t1,t2 = 0,0 rpsOld,stoT,afrT,floS,fuelM = 0,0,0,0,0.0000001
delay = {} for i = 1,5 do delay[i] = {0.0000001, 0.0000001} end
function clamp(x,min,max) return m.max(m.min(x,m.max(max,min)),m.min(min,max)) end
function lerp(min,max,t) local t = clamp(t,0,1) return min*(1-t)+max*t end
function pid(p,i,d) return{p=p,i=i,d=d,error=0,diff=0,integral=0, run=function(s,sp,pv,min,max,maxI,mult) local maxI,mult = maxI or max,mult or 1 local error,diff,out error = sp-pv diff = error-s.error s.error = error out = error*s.p*mult+s.integral+diff*s.d*mult if out > min and out < max then s.integral = clamp(s.integral+error*s.i*mult,min,maxI) end return clamp(error*s.p*mult+s.integral+diff*s.d*mult,min,max) end } end
pidEngine = pid(0.1, 0.002, 0)
function onTick() air = gn(1) fuel = gn(2) temp = gn(3) rps = gn(4) con = gn(5) dyn = gn(6) onPulse = gn(7) > 0 and not on on = gn(7) > 0
rpsSp = mode and clamp(con,2.1,60) or lerp(rpsMin, rpsMax, con)
if prot == 0 then rpsSp = lerp(rpsSp, 2.1, (temp-105)/10) elseif prot == 1 then if temp > 110 then heat = true elseif temp < 100 then heat = false end end if not heat and on and rps >= 2 then if air == 0 and fuel == 0 and temp == 0 then cyl = true afr = (dyn >= 12.6 and dyn <= 15) and dyn or afrP airM = pidEngine:run(rpsSp, rps, 0, 1) fuelM = airM*6.88/afr afrT = afr stoT = 0 else cyl = false flo = m.min(fuel/fuelM,0.1) floS = floS+clamp(flo-floS,-0.001,0.001) thr = pidEngine:run(rpsSp, rps, 0, 1, m.max(fuelM,0.1), 0.0015/(floS+0.0015)) air = m.max(air,0.0000001) temp = clamp(temp,0,100) if mix then afr = (dyn >= 12.6 and dyn <= 15) and dyn or afrP sto = (temp+(1400-100*afr))/(3*temp+200) else sto = (dyn >= 0.1 and dyn <= 1) and dyn or stoP end stoOpt = opt and 0.5 or sto airD,fuelD = delay[5][1],delay[5][2]
airM = clamp(-(1000000*thr*fuel*airD*((3*sto-1)*temp+(200*sto-1400)))/(100000000*air*fuelD),0.0001,1) fuelM = clamp(thr,0.0000001,clamp(-(100000000*air*fuelD)/(1000000*fuel*airD*((3*stoOpt-1)*temp+(200*stoOpt-1400))),0.0001,1))
afrT = clamp(air/m.max(fuel,0.0000001),0,99) stoT = clamp((temp+(1400-100*afrT))/(3*temp+200),-1,1) end else airM,fuelM,afrT,stoT = 0.0000001,0.0000001,0,0 pidEngine:run(0,0,0,0,0,0) end
if rpsOld >= 2 and rps < 2 then stall = true end if auto or onPulse then stall = false end if rps >= 2 then t1,t2 = 0,m.min(t2+1,30) else t1,t2 = m.min(t1+1,60),0 end if on and not stall and t2 < 30 and t1 >= 60 and not heat then start = true elseif not on or heat or t2 >= 30 then start = false end
rpsOld=rps
for i = 5,2,-1 do delay[i] = delay[i-1] end delay[1] = {airM, fuelM}
sn(1, airM) sn(2, fuelM) sn(3, rps) sn(4, gn(3)) sn(5, stoT) sn(6, afrT) sn(7, fuel*60)
sb(1, start) sb(2, cyl) end

object.script:
grace = 15 max = 12 min = 6 gear = 1 function onTick() if grace > 0 then grace = grace - 1 end
rps = input.getNumber(1) manual = input.getBool(1) gearUp = input.getBool(2) gearDown = input.getBool(3)
if manual and grace == 0 then if gearUp and gear < input.getNumber(2) then gear = gear + 1 grace = 15 end if (gearDown or rps < 3) and gear > 1 then gear = gear - 1 grace = 15 end else if grace == 0 then if rps > 12 and gear < input.getNumber(2) then gear = gear + 1 grace = 15 end if rps < 6 and gear > 1 then gear = gear - 1 grace = 15 end end end
output.setNumber(1, gear) end

object.script:
doors = 0 missile = 0 firstTimer = 0 secondTimer = 0 statusOfDoors = false statusOfMissileRise = false function onTick() prepareToFire = input.getBool(2) supports = input.getBool(13)
if supports then if firstTimer <= 60 then firstTimer = firstTimer + 1 end else if firstTimer >= 0 then firstTimer = firstTimer - 1 end end
if prepareToFire and firstTimer >= 60 then doors = 1
if secondTimer < 301 then secondTimer = secondTimer + 1 end
if secondTimer >= 300 then missile = 1 statusOfMissileRise = true end
if secondTimer > 120 then statusOfDoors = true end else missile = 0 statusOfMissileRise = false
if secondTimer > -1 then secondTimer = secondTimer - 1 end
if secondTimer <= 0 then doors = 0 end
if secondTimer < 120 then statusOfDoors = false end end
output.setNumber(1, doors) output.setNumber(2, missile) output.setBool(3, statusOfDoors) output.setBool(4, statusOfMissileRise) end

local GRAVITY = 9.8 local MAX_HEIGHT = 40000 local TICK_RATE = 1/60
local parabola_a = 0 local parabola_b = 0 local parabola_c = 0 local parabola_direction_x = 0 local parabola_direction_y = 0 local parabola_length = 0 local parabola_initialized = false
local startX = 0 local startY = 0 local startZ = 0
local targetXMem = 0 local targetYMem = 0 local targetZMem = 0
local function normalize(x, y) local length = math.sqrt(x*x + y*y) if length > 0 and length == length then return x/length, y/length end return 0, 0 end
local function dot(x1, y1, x2, y2) return x1*x2 + y1*y2 end
local function calculateParabola(startX, startY, startZ, targetX, targetY, targetZ, peakHeight) local dx = targetX - startX local dy = targetY - startY local horizontalDist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) if horizontalDist < 0.001 then return 0, 0, startZ, 1, 0, 0.001 end local dirX, dirY = normalize(dx, dy) local h = horizontalDist local h2 = h/2 local c = startZ local A = h2*h2 local B = h2 local C = h*h local D = h local E = peakHeight - c local F = targetZ - c local det = A*D - B*C
if math.abs(det) < 0.000001 then return 0, 0, c, dirX, dirY, h end
local det_a = E*D - B*F local det_b = A*F - E*C
local a = det_a/det local b = det_b/det
if a ~= a or b ~= b or c ~= c then return 0, 0, startZ, dirX, dirY, h end
return a, b, c, dirX, dirY, h end
local function getDesiredHeight(currentX, currentY, startX, startY, a, b, c, dirX, dirY, totalLength) local projX = currentX - startX local projY = currentY - startY local t = dot(projX, projY, dirX, dirY)
if t ~= t then t = 0 end
t = math.max(0, math.min(t, totalLength))
local desiredZ = a*t*t + b*t + c
if desiredZ ~= desiredZ then desiredZ = c end
return desiredZ end
local function calculateTargetPitch(currentX, currentY, currentZ, currentPitchRad, startX, startY, startZ, targetX, targetY, targetZ, a, b, c, dirX, dirY, totalLength)
local projX = currentX - startX local projY = currentY - startY local t = dot(projX, projY, dirX, dirY)
if t ~= t then t = 0 end
t = math.max(0, math.min(t, totalLength))
local slope = 2*a*t + b
if slope ~= slope then slope = 0 end
local angleFromHorizon = math.atan(slope)
local targetPitchFromVertical = math.pi/2 - angleFromHorizon
local desiredZ = a*t*t + b*t + c local heightError = desiredZ - currentZ
local heightCorrection = heightError * 0.01
local targetPitch = targetPitchFromVertical + heightCorrection
local maxPitch = math.pi local minPitch = 0
targetPitch = math.max(minPitch, math.min(maxPitch, targetPitch))
if targetPitch ~= targetPitch then targetPitch = currentPitchRad end
return targetPitch end
function onTick() local currentX = input.getNumber(1) or 0 local currentY = input.getNumber(3) or 0 local currentZ = input.getNumber(2) or 0 local currentPitch = input.getNumber(15) or 0
local targetX = input.getNumber(18) or 0 local targetY = input.getNumber(19) or 0 local targetZ = input.getNumber(20) or 0
local start = input.getBool(1) or false
local currentPitchRad = currentPitch * math.pi * 2
if start and not parabola_initialized then startX = currentX startY = currentY startZ = currentZ
targetXMem = targetX targetYMem = targetY targetZMem = targetZ
local dx = targetXMem - startX local dy = targetYMem - startY local horizontalDist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) or 0
local peakHeight = math.min(MAX_HEIGHT, math.max(1000, horizontalDist * 0.2))
if targetZMem > startZ then peakHeight = math.max(peakHeight, targetZMem + 1000) end
peakHeight = math.min(peakHeight, MAX_HEIGHT)
parabola_a, parabola_b, parabola_c, parabola_direction_x, parabola_direction_y, parabola_length = calculateParabola( startX, startY, startZ, targetXMem, targetYMem, targetZMem, peakHeight )
parabola_initialized = true end
local targetPitch = currentPitchRad local desiredZ = 0 local peakHeight = 0
if parabola_initialized then targetPitch = calculateTargetPitch( currentX, currentY, currentZ, currentPitchRad, startX, startY, startZ, targetXMem, targetYMem, targetZMem, parabola_a, parabola_b, parabola_c, parabola_direction_x, parabola_direction_y, parabola_length ) or currentPitchRad
desiredZ = getDesiredHeight( currentX, currentY, startX, startY, parabola_a, parabola_b, parabola_c, parabola_direction_x, parabola_direction_y, parabola_length ) or 0
local dx = targetXMem - startX local dy = targetYMem - startY local horizontalDist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) or 0 peakHeight = math.min(MAX_HEIGHT, math.max(1000, horizontalDist * 0.2)) if targetZMem > startZ then peakHeight = math.max(peakHeight, targetZMem + 1000) end peakHeight = math.min(peakHeight, MAX_HEIGHT) end
output.setNumber(1, targetPitch or 0) output.setNumber(2, (desiredZ * 3) or 0) output.setNumber(3, peakHeight or 0) output.setNumber(4, startX or 0) output.setNumber(5, startY or 0) output.setNumber(6, startZ or 0) output.setNumber(7, targetXMem or 0) output.setNumber(8, targetYMem or 0) output.setNumber(9, targetZMem or 0) output.setNumber(10, parabola_a or 0) end
